title: Page 9
lines: 齐藤浅羽不躲不闪，任父亲在身上胡打一通，可嘴巴还是不住地说：“不然要怎么样？难道她知道我不是她当初爱上的那个人，还会愿意留下来？难道她明明知道大哥才是她本来爱的那个人，却还要留下来当大哥的弟媳吗？爸，这不是我想将她留下就留下的问题！不是吗？”
这些，齐藤泷一又岂会不知？
就是因为这样，他才会一筹莫展啊！
“我干脆先打死你好了，这样我对冬末也好交代——”说着，气喘吁吁地又继续打。
齐藤英树终是走上前来阻止了父亲，把他拉回座位上坐好，然后，他缓缓地扫视他们，这才淡道：“事情还有转圜的余地，你们别吵了。”
闻言，几人不由得都抬头看向他——
“你快说！”齐藤泷一第一个着急。
齐藤英树目光淡淡地掠过众人。“我娶她。”
此言一出，安本香子心喜万分，眉梢都染了笑，齐藤浅羽则是抿着唇，沉默地看着齐藤英树，未置一词。
“你说什么？”齐藤泷一愣了下，马上叱道：“荒唐！这怎么可以？她已经嫁给了浅羽，当初巫师说了，她必须嫁给浅羽，并真心为他祈求——”
“她是嫁了，浅羽也醒了，不是吗？可当初冬末和浅羽的婚事非常低调，知道这桩婚事的根本没几个人。”
这是事实。当初根本不知道舞冬末是否真的救得了浅羽，为了保护舞冬末，齐藤家答应过舞家，事若不成，绝对不会告知外界她已婚的事实，并会奉上一笔本该属于浅羽那一份的财产，也因此，婚礼低调到不行，外界也没人知道齐藤家二少爷已婚之事。
“所以呢？”
“爸爸既然怕人家说我们过河拆桥，忘恩负义，冬末又已经知道了事情的真相，不可能再待在浅羽身边，事已至此，别无他法了，不是吗？”齐藤英树说出了他思考后的结论。“我这回明媒正娶舞冬末，昭告世人，齐藤家既不忘恩负义，也算报恩。”
齐藤英树语调清淡，但言词坚定，这通常表示他心意已决，不容更改。
“不行！”齐藤泷一还是无法接受。
齐藤英树神情一冷，笑道：“那就当这婚事没发生过，让她走吧。走出齐藤家大门之后，她要怎么对人说，我们谁都没资格说什么。”
“你——”这不是拿着齐藤家的清誉和名声去赌吗？就像一个不知何时何地会爆开的不定时炸弹，保证把人搞疯。齐藤泷一的老脸终是很不甘地垂下，眉头都皱成一团。“话虽这么说，这齐藤家上上下下的，谁不知她是二少奶奶？”
“把这些人都换掉吧，除了石嫂。”齐藤英树决然地道。
齐藤泷一定定地看着大儿子。“你这是……决定了？”
“是的，爸爸。”
“可是，你爱冬末吗？她是浅羽的救命恩人，就算浅羽用他一辈子来还也是应该的，可是你……”
“欺骗她的人是我。”齐藤英树打断了齐藤泷一的话。“我愿意承担这一切后果，算是赎罪。”
或许，事情早该这么办了。
如果他早知道浅羽有意中人，而且还是在家里头的妹妹香子，他当初还会放心地把冬末交给浅羽吗？
他不只欺骗了她，现在还伤害了她，她听到事实后会有多痛？他连想都不敢去想。
就是因为这样，当初才会选择了隐瞒，打算彻头彻尾地欺骗下去……
可终究，纸包不住火啊。
接下来，他该如何面对她？
舞冬末这一发烧，整整烧了一个星期才退，其间断断续续地醒来又昏睡，乖乖地吃药喝水，却是一句话也不说。
偶尔睁眼，看见了他，那个总是在她身旁照顾她的男人，她甚至不想弄清这男人究竟是浅羽还是英树，就只是单纯地配合着吃药喝水，然后闭上眼睛睡觉。
她很想睡长长的一觉，很长很长，长到让她忘了所有的事，最好烧掉她的记忆，烧掉那被心爱的男人狠狠欺骗抛弃的难堪与痛苦，或者，醒来之后有人可以对她说——那不过是场梦罢了。
如果可以这样多好？
在病中，她一直如此企盼着。
可惜天不从人愿，再不想面对的现实，也终有要去面对的一天——
这日，她终是在长长的一觉中醒了过来，让人开了窗，那窗外的樱花也像要探进屋里瞧她一眼似的，似乎枝桠都长长了些。
空气闻起来特别清新，她深深地吸了一口气，像想起什么似的，便往那丫头看了过去。
“你是新来的？叫什么名字？”看上去这丫头的年纪应该跟她相差不远。
丫头听了赶紧上前一步，低头小心应道：“小姐，我叫紫儿，是齐藤家新进的丫头。”
“本来的丫头呢？”
紫儿摇摇头。“这个紫儿不知道。听说前头那几位是因为侍候小姐侍候得不好，这才全换了一批新的。”
舞冬末轻轻蹙了眉头。“之前的丫头全换了？”
“听说是这样的。”紫儿小小声地答道。“小姐，你醒了，我这就去回一下大少爷和老爷，他们超担心你的，尤其是大少爷，天天下课后都来守着小姐到天亮呢，就怕紫儿没把你照顾好。”
闻言，舞冬末好笑地看着她。“你不是新来的吗？怎么知道来看我的是大少爷还是二少爷？”
紫儿偷偷抬起头来瞧她一眼。“小姐，你是开玩笑吧？你都要嫁给大少爷了，天天来看你的自然是大少爷啊，何况二少爷身边总跟着香子小姐呢，也不是太难认……总不至于，二少爷故意装成大少爷来看你吧？”
这丫头究竟在胡说八道什么？
舞冬末才刚觉得清醒的脑袋，突然之间又被她搞晕了，一时之间竟有点反应不过来。
“你刚刚说什么？我要嫁给大少爷？”就算是新来的丫头，这样的认知也未免太夸张了吧？她明明是二少奶奶，大家都叫她二少奶奶……
想着，舞冬末的脑袋瓜像是突然间被雷劈到！
她愣愣地瞪着紫儿那丫头，还没开口问话，就听见门口传来一道温柔好听的低嗓。
“你终于醒了，舞冬末。”齐藤英树俊美的脸庞带着淡笑，深黑的眸子瞬也不瞬地盯着她。
他看起来精神奕奕，哪有天天守她到天亮的疲惫模样？甚至，他看起来比以前又更俊了些。
舞冬末淡淡地撇开眼，脑袋嗡嗡的，她在面对他时更不能思考了。
齐藤英树转头吩咐紫儿。“你叫厨房弄点适合小姐吃的过来。”
“是，大少爷。”紫儿乖巧地应声去了，走时不忘替他们关好门。
齐藤英树走到床边坐下来，伸手去握舞冬末露在被子外的手，她一惊要缩手，他却硬是握着不放，力道拿捏得很好，她既挣不脱，他也不会弄伤她。
舞冬末抬眸瞪着他，双眼又是气又是恼。“你这是干什么？”
“原谅我，舞冬末。虽然我知道我所做的一切都不可原谅，可我还是希望你可以原谅我，为了救浅羽，我不得不这么做。”齐藤英树握着她的手，眼神真挚地看着她。“先听我说好吗？说完了，你要打要骂都随你。”
舞冬末瞪着他，眼眶瞬间便被雾气给填满。
她不想听！一点都不想听他是怎么计划欺骗她的！可如果不听，她觉得自己更像个呆子，都已经傻傻地被骗了这么久，总得搞清楚前因后果吧？
她咬唇。“你说。”
content_en:
Saito Asayu did not dodge, and allowed his father to beat him all over the body, but he kept saying: "What else? Does she know that I am not the person she fell in love with at the beginning, and is she still willing to stay? Does she know that her eldest brother is the one she originally loved, but she still wants to stay and be his sister-in-law? Dad, this is not a question of keeping her just because I want to! Isn't it?"
How could Saito Takiichi not know this?
It's because of this that he is at a loss!
"I might as well beat you to death first, so that I can be accountable to the end of the winter -" He continued to beat you while panting.
Saito Hideki finally stepped forward to stop his father, and pulled him back to his seat. Then, he slowly glanced at them, and then said calmly: "There is still room for change, so don't argue."
Hearing this, several people couldn't help but look up at him——
"Speak quickly!" Saito Takiichi was the first to be anxious.
Saito Hideki glanced across the crowd indifferently. "I'll marry her."
As soon as these words came out, Yasumoto Kouko was extremely happy and her eyebrows were dyed with a smile. Saito Asaha pursed her lips and looked at Saito Hideki in silence without saying a word.
"What did you say?" Saito Taki was stunned for a moment, then immediately yelled: "Absurd! How is this possible? She has already married Asayu. The wizard said at the beginning that she must marry Asayu and sincerely pray for him-"
"She is married, and Qian Yu is awake, right? But the marriage between Dong Lu and Qian Yu was very low-key back then, and not many people knew about it."
This is true. At the beginning, I had no idea whether Mai Tou Sue could really save Asa Yu. In order to protect Mai Tou Sue, the Saito family promised the Mai family that if things failed, they would never inform the outside world of the fact that she was married, and would donate a sum of property that should belong to Asa Yu. Therefore, the wedding was extremely low-key, and no one outside knew that the second young master of the Saito family was married.
"So?"
"Since Dad is afraid that people will say that we are ungrateful by crossing the river and burning bridges, and at the end of winter, we already know the truth of the matter, and it is impossible to stay with Asaha anymore. The matter has come to this, and there is no other way, right?" Saito Hideki expressed his conclusion after thinking. "This time I, the matchmaker, am marrying Wu Dongmo. I want to tell the world that the Saito family is not ungrateful and can be considered as repaying their kindness."
Saito Hideki's tone is light but his words are firm, which usually means that his mind has been made up and cannot be changed.
"No!" Saito Takiichi still couldn't accept it.
Saito Hideki's expression turned cold and he said with a smile: "Then just pretend that this marriage never happened and let her go. After walking out of Saito's house, what will she say to others? None of us are qualified to say anything."
"You——" Isn't this a gamble with the reputation and reputation of the Saito family? It's like a time bomb that will explode at some point or another, guaranteed to drive people crazy. Saito Takiichi's old face finally dropped unwillingly, and his brows knitted together. "That being said, who in the Saito family knows that she is the second young mistress?"
"Replace all these people, except Mrs. Shi." Hideki Saito said decisively.
Saito Taki looked at his eldest son intently. "Have you... decided?"
"Yes, Dad."
"But, do you love Dongmo? She is Qianyu's savior. Even if Qianyu spends his whole life to repay her, she should, but you..."
"I was the one who deceived her." Saito Hideki interrupted Saito Takichi. "I am willing to bear all the consequences of this as atonement."
Perhaps, things should have been done this way long ago.
If he had known that Qianyu was interested in someone, and it was his sister Xiangzi at home, would he still have given the end of winter to Qianyu with confidence?
Not only had he deceived her, but now he had hurt her. How painful would it be for her to hear the truth? He didn't even dare to think about it.
It was because of this that I chose to conceal it in the first place and planned to continue to deceive him outright...
But after all, paper cannot contain the fire.
How should he face her next?
Chapter 11(1)
Wu had a fever at the end of winter, which lasted for a whole week before it subsided. During this period, he woke up and fell asleep intermittently. He took medicine and drank water obediently, but did not say a word.
Occasionally she opened her eyes and saw him, the man who was always by her side to take care of her. She didn't even want to find out whether this man was Asaba or Hideki, she just simply took medicine and drank water, then closed her eyes and slept.
She wanted to sleep for a long time, so long that she would forget everything. It would be best to burn away her memory and the embarrassment and pain of being deceived and abandoned by the man she loved. Or, after she woke up, someone could tell her that it was just a dream.
How nice would it be?
During her illness, she had been looking forward to this.
It’s a pity that God doesn’t follow people’s wishes, and the reality that we no longer want to face will eventually have to be faced one day——
On this day, she finally woke up from a long sleep and asked someone to open the window. The cherry blossoms outside the window seemed to be looking into the room to take a look at her. It seemed that the branches had grown longer.
The air smelled particularly fresh. She took a deep breath and looked at the girl as if she remembered something.
"Are you new here? What's your name?" It seems that this girl should be about the same age as her.
After hearing this, the girl quickly stepped forward, lowered her head and said carefully: "Miss, my name is Zi'er, and I am the new girl of the Saito family."
"Where's the original girl?"
Zi'er shook her head. "I don't know about this Zi'er. I heard that the first few were replaced by a new batch because the waitress didn't serve them well."
Wu Dongmo frowned slightly. "Have all the girls from before been replaced?"
"I heard that's the case." Zi'er replied in a low voice. "Miss, you're awake. I'm going to go back to the young master and the master right now. They are very worried about you, especially the young master. He comes to guard the miss after class every day until dawn, just because Zi'er doesn't take good care of you."
Hearing this, Wu Dongmo looked at her funny. "Aren't you new here? How do you know if the person who comes to see me is the eldest young master or the second young master?"
Zi'er secretly raised her head to take a look at her. "Miss, are you kidding me? You are about to marry the eldest young master. Of course it is the eldest young master who comes to see you every day. Besides, the second young master is always accompanied by Miss Xiangzi. It is not too difficult to recognize... It is not like the second young master deliberately pretends to be the eldest young master to come to see you, right?"
What the hell is this girl talking about?
Wu Dongmo's head, which had just started to wake up, was suddenly stunned by her again, and she was unable to react for a while.
"What did you just say? I want to marry the eldest young master?" Even for a new girl, this understanding is too exaggerated, right? She is obviously the Second Young Mistress, everyone calls her the Second Young Mistress...
Thinking about it, Wu Dongmo's head felt like it was suddenly struck by lightning!
She stared blankly at that girl Zi'er. Before she could ask any questions, she heard a gentle and pleasant voice coming from the door.
"You're finally awake, Wu Dongmo." Saito Hideki's handsome face had a faint smile, and his dark eyes stared at her for a moment.
He looked in high spirits, how could he look tired from watching her till dawn every day? He even looked more handsome than before.
Wu Dongmo rolled her eyes away indifferently, her head was buzzing, and she couldn't think anymore when facing him.
Saito Hideki turned around and ordered Zi'er. "You ask the kitchen to bring over something suitable for young lady."
"Yes, young master." Zi'er responded obediently, not forgetting to close the door for them before leaving.
Saito Hideki walked to the bed and sat down, reaching out to hold Wu Dongmo's hand that was exposed outside the quilt. She was startled and wanted to shrink her hand, but he insisted on holding on, with good strength. She couldn't break away, and he wouldn't hurt her.
Wu Dongmo raised her eyes and stared at him, her eyes full of anger and annoyance. "What are you doing?"
"Forgive me, Wu Dongsue. Although I know that everything I did is unforgivable, I still hope you can forgive me. In order to save Qian Yu, I have to do this." Saito Hideki held her hand and looked at her sincerely. "Listen to me first, okay? After I finish speaking, you can hit or scold me if you want."
Wu Dongmo stared at him, her eyes instantly filled with mist.
She doesn't want to hear it! She didn't want to hear how he planned to deceive her! But if she didn't listen, she would feel more like an idiot. She had been fooled for so long, so she had to figure out the cause and effect, right?
She bit her lip. "you say."
